minecraft.about.description: Modpack management, mod browsing and launching for Minecraft.
minecraft.about.nihao_client.description: The Minecraft mod that connects the game to the launcher: Ely.by skins and the screenshot gallery.
minecraft.content_manager.readonly_hint: This modpack is managed by its service, so its content can only be viewed. Detach it in the modpack settings to change it.
minecraft.content_manager.title: Content manager
minecraft.create_modpack.browse_variant_: Find and download a modpack from online services.
minecraft.create_modpack.custom_variant_: Start from scratch by picking a loader and game version.
minecraft.create_modpack.install_variant: Load a modpack file — our own format, Modrinth's .mrpack or a CurseForge pack.
minecraft.create_modpack.title: Create Modpack
minecraft.create_modpack.use_nihao_clien: Adds our mod to the instance: Ely.by skins and the screenshot gallery.
minecraft.launch.crash_ai_copy: Copy the prompt to ask AI
minecraft.launch.crash_ai_lead: Let AI help you understand the crash: copy the prompt, then paste it into an AI of your choice.
minecraft.launch.crash_ai_step1: Copy the prompt to ask AI
minecraft.launch.crash_ai_step2: Open an AI platform and paste the prompt
minecraft.launch.missing_cleanup: Delete the {n} file(s) you downloaded from your Downloads folder? They are already in the instance.
minecraft.launch.missing_found: Found {n} in your Downloads folder and added to the instance.
minecraft.launch.missing_hint: Their authors don't allow downloading these outside CurseForge. Press Download on each (the download starts on its page), then Check: files found in your Downloads folder are added to the instance for you.
minecraft.launch.missing_none: Nothing new found in the instance or in your Downloads folder.
minecraft.launch.missing_wrong_build: {files} in Downloads is another version than the pack needs.
minecraft.launch.nihao_client_missing: Your skin won't be visible in the game. Want it? Install NiHao Client.
minecraft.launch.nihao_client_on_hint: Ely.by skins and the screenshot gallery work in this modpack.
minecraft.launch.nihao_client_update_hin: A newer NiHao Client is out for this modpack
minecraft.launch.playtime_empty: Nothing to show yet: the breakdown fills in as you play.
minecraft.launch.playtime_hint: Counted from the game log while you play.
minecraft.market.title: Modpack market
minecraft.modpack_settings.delete_confir: Delete "{name}"? This removes all its saves and mods permanently.
minecraft.modpack_settings.delete_hint: Permanently removes its saves, mods and settings.
minecraft.modpack_settings.detach_servic: Detach "{name}" from {service}? It becomes a custom instance; its files stay as they are.
Detached: this is a custom instance now.
Makes this a custom instance: you can then change its name, icon, banner and content, and it no longer follows {service}. Its files stay exactly as they are.
minecraft.modpack_settings.downloaded_hi: This instance was downloaded from Public — its icon, banner, name and content are managed by the server, not locally.
minecraft.modpack_settings.duplicate_hin: Makes a copy of this instance under the name you enter, with all its files.
minecraft.modpack_settings.java_path_hin: Use a specific Java installation for this modpack. Leave empty to let the launcher pick and manage Java itself.
minecraft.modpack_settings.jvm_args_hint: Extra arguments passed to Java when the game starts. Only change them if you know what they do.
minecraft.modpack_settings.max_ram_hint: The most memory this modpack may use. Heavy modpacks need more, but too much starves the rest of your system.
minecraft.modpack_settings.name_hint: The name shown for this modpack in the launcher.
minecraft.modpack_settings.publish_delet: Permanently delete this pack from the server? Every published build, its icon/banner, and everyone else's ability to download it disappear immediately. This cannot be undone.
Couldn't delete the pack from NiHao.
Permanently deletes this pack from the server — every published build, its icon/banner, and everyone else's ability to download it. Irreversible.
minecraft.modpack_settings.publish_detac: Detach this instance from the published pack? You can re-publish it later to reattach.
Stops this instance tracking the published pack. Doesn't touch the server — the pack, its builds, and everyone else's copy stay exactly as they are; only this local instance forgets it published it.
minecraft.modpack_settings.publish_id_hi: The pack's identifier on the server and the number of its latest published build.
minecraft.modpack_settings.publish_invit: Gives another player access to this invite-only pack. Enter their NiHao login.
minecraft.modpack_settings.publish_name_: The name of the pack as other players see it in Public.
minecraft.modpack_settings.publish_not_f: This account can't see this pack on the server anymore — it may have been removed some other way. You can still detach it below.
minecraft.modpack_settings.publish_not_o: You're not the owner of this pack — only detaching is available here.
minecraft.modpack_settings.publish_visib: Public: anyone can find and download it. Invite-only: only players you invite.
minecraft.modpack_settings.repair_hint: Re-checks and re-downloads any missing or broken files.
minecraft.modpack_settings.repair_hint_p: Re-checks the game's files and the pack's own: whatever is missing or broken is downloaded again from {service}.
minecraft.modpack_settings.repair_starte: Re-verifying files — watch the progress bar at the bottom.
minecraft.modpack_settings.source_hint: This instance was installed from {service} — its icon, banner, name and content are managed by it, not locally. Detach it to change them.
minecraft.modpack_settings.title: Modpack settings
minecraft.modpack_settings.use_custom_ra: Use custom RAM for this modpack
Give this modpack its own memory limit instead of the general one from Game settings.
minecraft.modpack_settings.use_general_r: Will use the general RAM allocation from Game settings at launch.
minecraft.modpack_settings.version_confi: Switch "{name}" to version {version}? The pack's files are replaced and those this version drops are deleted; changes you made to the pack's configs are overwritten. Saves and settings stay.
minecraft.modpack_settings.version_hint: Move this instance to a newer or an older build of the pack. The pack's files are replaced; your saves and settings stay.
minecraft.modpack_settings.version_start: Switching to {version} — watch the progress bar at the bottom.
minecraft.modpacks_list.badge_archived: Archived — no longer on the server
minecraft.modpacks_list.delete_confirm: Delete "{name}"? This removes all its saves and mods permanently.
minecraft.modpacks_list.empty: No instances yet — create one to get started.
minecraft.modpacks_list.public_no_permis: Your account doesn't have permission to view public modpacks.
minecraft.modpacks_list.public_signin_re: Sign in to your NiHao account to see public modpacks.
minecraft.profiles.drop_hint: Drop a skin PNG to try it on
minecraft.profiles.elyby_changes_hint: Ely.by changes skins on its site. Upload there, then press Refresh.
minecraft.profiles.elyby_password_hint: With two-factor authentication, type the password, a colon and the code: password:123456. The password is not saved, only the sign-in token.
minecraft.profiles.preview_note: You are looking at a skin you dropped here. It is only a preview: it is not used anywhere.
minecraft.profiles.preview_only: This is only a preview: nothing is saved. Upload the skin on ely.by to keep it.
minecraft.profiles.preview_reset: Back to the profile's own skin
minecraft.profiles.wardrobe_locked: An offline profile has no skin, so the wardrobe is closed. Sign in with Ely.by to open it.
minecraft.screenshots.empty: No screenshots yet — press F2 in game.
New modpacks start with the NiHao Client mod (Ely.by skins, screenshot gallery) turned on when a build exists for their loader and game version. You can still change it per modpack.
minecraft.settings.ram.hint: Memory Minecraft may use by default. Instances with their own RAM setting ignore it. Too little makes the game stutter; too much starves the rest of your system.
minecraft.settings.ram.label: RAM allocation (MB)
minecraft.share.hint: Export this instance to a file someone else can install — no server involved.
minecraft.share.mrpack_format_hint: Standard format other launchers understand. Needs internet to look up mods on Modrinth.
minecraft.share.no_files: This instance has no files yet.
minecraft.share.nothing_selected: Select at least one folder or file to export.
minecraft.share.own_format_hint: Self-contained — bundles every file, ready to unzip and use.
minecraft.share.packing_compress_hint: A manifest with every file's checksum and the files under overrides/, like a CurseForge pack.
minecraft.share.packing_full_hint: The files as they are in a plain zip, with the instance's profile.nihao next to them.
minecraft.share.publish_format_hint: Upload to the NiHao server so friends can download it in-app.
minecraft.share.publish_no_permission: Your account doesn't have permission to publish modpacks.
minecraft.share.publish_signin_required: Sign in to your NiHao account to publish modpacks.
minecraft.share.publish_stale_owner: This instance's linked pack is no longer owned by this account. Detach it in the instance's Publish settings, then publish again to register a new one.
minecraft.share.publish_update_hint: A new build of "{name}" will be uploaded.
minecraft.share.title: Share modpack
